headline: Apple adds M6 chip to 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac
summary: Apple updated the 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac with its new M6 chip, adding more cores, faster memory and better connectivity; the 16-inch MacBook Pro keeps the older M5. Outlets differ on which generation preceded the M6 iMac, citing either the M4 or the M5 as its predecessor.

claims.statement: Apple introduced the M6 chip in the 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac.

claims.statement: The 16-inch MacBook Pro was not updated and still uses the older M5 chip.

sources.quote: Sadly, the 16-inch MBP is still stuck with older M5 silicon.

claims.statement: The new MacBook Pro offers 24 hours of battery life plus Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.
